requirement.text: decorate ALL generated code with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage
requirement.formal_obligation: For every supported target framework, every generated code declaration carries ExcludeFromCodeCoverage.
assumptions: supported target frameworks are those the shipped src/ projects list
the T4 templates are the source of the generated declarations
C# conditional compilation selects code by the framework symbols a build defines

claims.statement: all generated code declarations carry ExcludeFromCodeCoverage
claims.formal: FORALL t in ShippedTFMs, d in GeneratedDeclarations(t): has(d, ExcludeFromCodeCoverage)

scope.declarations: generated by the committed T4 templates
scope.checked_by: static guard evaluation, not a full compile

claims.statement: every checked-in generated .cs is the current output of the .tt beside it
claims.formal: FORALL (tt, cs) in TemplatePairs: changed(tt) == changed(cs)

scope.pairs: T4 templates and their committed outputs

claims.statement: the existing test suite can observe this change
claims.formal: EXISTS t in TestedTFMs: t in ExcludedTFMs
